text: At the surface, it's bright, warm, and full of life, but sunlight fades fast in water.
By 200 meters, it's like dusk. Most of the colors are gone.
Red disappears first, then yellow, then green, until only a deep blue is left.
By 1,000 meters, the sunlight is gone completely. From here to the bottom, it's the darkest
place you can imagine. Darker than any night on land. Can somebody switch on a light? Someone
already has. Down here, animals make their own light. It's called bioluminescence. Jellyfish
flash blue when they're touched, some shrimp speak glowing clouds to escape, and the angler
fish carries a little glowing lure on its head like a fishing rod and waits for something
Don't go towards the light, never go towards the light!
And we're only one kilometer down.
